questions.question: How do you want to run the 5 smoke scenarios on the host?

options.label: Live, one scenario at a time (Recommended)
options.description: You run S1, paste the daemon.log excerpt here, I confirm pass/fail and we move to S2. Slower but each scenario is verified before the next; failures get root-caused in flow.

options.label: Batched — run all 5, paste results at end
options.description: You run S1→S5 on the host uninterrupted, paste all excerpts at the end. Faster if all pass; harder to root-cause interleaved failures.

options.label: Prep a host log-tail script via /watch-log
options.description: I generate a bash script the host runs to tail daemon.log + the 4 JSONL files with color-coded prefixes, and auto-detect completion when all 5 scenarios' expected lines have appeared.

questions.question: The smoke plan references `[notify-app] Allow via inbox for <notif_id>` but the daemon actually emits `[notify-app] allow ack written for sid=... rid=...`. How to handle?

options.label: Use actual string during smoke, log the drift in LOG.md gotchas (Recommended)
options.description: Cheapest fix — the prompt file is historical, the code is authoritative. Session 5 LOG.md notes the drift; no code touched.

options.label: Patch session-5-e2e-smoke.md prompt to match code
options.description: Corrects the prompt file for future re-runs. Small doc edit; but session prompts are usually left as historical artifacts once delivered.

options.label: Add the missing log line to notify-app.js
options.description: Emit both strings (current + "Allow via inbox for <notif_id>"). Small code change motivated by doc consistency, not smoke failure — probably out of scope for session 5's "no new features" DoD.

questions.question: Le smoke session 5 est bloqué par l'absence du binaire `notif` sur le host. Comment tu veux débloquer ?

options.label: Build + install manuel maintenant (Recommandé)
options.description: Je te prep un script `cargo build --release -p notif-cli` dans apps/notifier + `install -m 755 target/release/notif /usr/local/bin/notif` (sudo) + `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine`. Restart daemon. Puis on reprend S1. Session 6 restera pour l'ergonomie wtf install.

options.label: Faire session 6 d'abord, puis revenir à session 5
options.description: On saute session 5, on livre session 6 (wtf notify install + binaires vendored dans .devcontainer/notify/vendor/), puis on rejoue tout le smoke sur un binaire propre. Plus long mais résoud le problème pour de bon.

options.label: Je réutilise un `notif` déjà installé ailleurs et je set NOTIF_BIN
options.description: Tu as un binaire ailleurs (ex: build local, copie de secours). Tu exportes `NOTIF_BIN=/chemin/vers/notif` dans l'env du daemon, restart, on reprend S1. Contourne l'install propre.

options.label: Oui, commit avec ce message (Recommandé)
options.description:
fix(notify): source Allow requestId from pending-perms.jsonl

Hook.js was reading payload.tool_use_id from the Claude Code PermissionRequest hook, but that field isn't provided. Even if it were, it'd be the model-side toolu_XXX — disjoint from the ext-side requestId that outbound-action-injector.py matches against pending permissions. Now sourced from pending-perms.jsonl (settled:false, matching sessionId). Surfaced during session 5 smoke.
